# TokenCosts AI (tokencostsai.com)

> Real-time LLM API pricing tracker, Prompt Caching & Batch 50% cost simulator, and Coding Agent token multiplier directory covering 363 frontier and open-weight models across 58 provider organizations (22 core labs).

TokenCosts AI normalizes per-1M-token input, output, cached-read, cache-write, and asynchronous batch rates in USD alongside context windows, throughput (tokens/sec), TTFT latency, and benchmark ELO scores. For machine-readable lookups, AI agents and automated FinOps pipelines should fetch the lightweight structured catalog at https://tokencostsai.com/pricing-summary.json (synced daily from verified vendor rate cards; last updated 2026-11-25).

Current market highlights (2026-11-25): Upstage Solar Mini 4.5 ($0.01/$0.04, 512K ctx, -90% cache to $0.001); DeepSeek V4.1 Flash ($0.14/$0.42, -97% cache $0.0042, -64% batch); GLM-5.3-Flash ($0.12/$0.38, -83% cache $0.02, -81% batch).

## Authoritative Data & API Endpoints

- [Structured Pricing Summary JSON](https://tokencostsai.com/pricing-summary.json): Lightweight machine-readable JSON feed of top benchmarked models across all 363 tracked LLMs with normalized input, output, cached read, batch discount, and context window fields.
- [Full Model Pricing Directory](https://tokencostsai.com/models/): Searchable, sortable catalog of 363 LLMs with provider direct vs. gateway rates and live latency metrics.
- [Interactive Token & Caching Cost Calculator](https://tokencostsai.com/calculator/): Simulate monthly spend with 95%+ Prompt Caching hit ratios, 50% Batch API offloading, and tiered long-context escalation.
- [Official AI Deals & Billing Changes Watch](https://tokencostsai.com/deals/): Daily-verified official Black Friday promos, anti-reseller policy disclosures, Mistral Vibe Pro credit removals, and upcoming Nov 30 / Dec 1 API pricing cliffs & endpoint retirements across 12 vendors.
- [Upstage Solar Mini 4.5 Live Cost Calculator](https://tokencostsai.com/calculator/solar-mini-4-5/): Ultra-low-floor 35B/3B-active MoE ($0.01/M input, $0.04/M output, $0.001/M cached read at 90% off, 512K context) for high-volume agent routing and classification workloads.
- [Developer SDK & LiteLLM Integration Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/developers/): Ready-to-run LiteLLM YAML, Vercel AI SDK, and OpenAI-compatible Python router configs plus embeddable SVG pricing badges.

## Coding Agent & Harness Benchmarks

- [Coding Agent Harness Cost Directory](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/): Measured real-world token multipliers (1.2x–3.8x), system prompt overhead, and BYOK cost optimization across 12 AI coding tools.
- [Claude Code Token Cost & BYOK Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/claude-code/): 1.8x–2.5x multiplier (~3,200 token overhead) — Anthropic's agentic terminal CLI with native prompt caching, subagent delegation, and /compact memory control.
- [Cursor Token Cost & BYOK Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/cursor/): 2.2x–3.5x multiplier (~4,200 token overhead) — Full-featured AI IDE with codebase indexing, Shadow Workspace lint verification, and multi-file Composer Agent.
- [Windsurf Token Cost & BYOK Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/windsurf/): 1.9x–2.8x multiplier (~3,600 token overhead) — Flow-driven AI IDE powered by Cascade engine with selective AST chunking and strict step-by-step tool control.
- [Aider Token Cost & BYOK Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/aider/): 1.2x–1.8x multiplier (~1,150 token overhead) — Token-frugal open-source CLI using Tree-sitter AST Repo-Map, Architect/Editor split, and clean Git auto-commits.
- [Cline Token Cost & BYOK Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/cline/): 2.0x–3.0x multiplier (~3,100 token overhead) — Autonomous open-source VS Code coding agent with step-by-step approval, real-time token cost readout, and full BYOK.
- [Roo Code Token Cost & BYOK Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/roo-code/): 1.7x–2.6x multiplier (~2,350 token overhead) — Multi-mode VS Code agent (Architect, Code, Debug, Ask) with per-mode system prompt pruning and model profiles.
- [OpenCode / Continue Token Cost & BYOK Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/opencode-continue/): 1.5x–2.3x multiplier (~1,850 token overhead) — Vendor-neutral open-source agent ecosystem (OpenCode TUI + Continue VS Code/JetBrains) via declarative config.yaml/json.
- [OpenAI Codex CLI Token Cost & BYOK Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/codex-cli/): 1.6x–2.4x multiplier (~6,900 token overhead) — OpenAI's open-source terminal agent built on the Responses API with warm 24h prefix caching, sandboxed execution, and custom model_providers.
- [DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Token Cost & BYOK Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/deepseek-harness/): 2.4x–3.8x multiplier (~4,800 token overhead) — DeepSeek's Cordis-powered open-source agent harness with Web UI (:3080), headless CLI, and append-only 90%–99% cache reuse.
- [ZCode Token Cost & BYOK Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/zcode/): 2.0x–3.1x multiplier (~3,400 token overhead) — Open-source agentic IDE (Desktop, Web & CLI) with /goal closed-loop execution and lock-in-free triple-protocol BYOK.
- [Muse Code Token Cost & BYOK Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/muse-code/): 2.1x–3.3x multiplier (~3,800 token overhead) — Meta's terminal CLI agent with git-worktree parallel subagents, /effort depth control, and MSP JSON-RPC SDK telemetry.
- [Google Antigravity Token Cost & BYOK Guide](https://tokencostsai.com/harness/antigravity/): 2.0x–3.2x multiplier (~6,500 token overhead) — Google's agent-first IDE & agy CLI featuring 512K auto-compaction checkpoints, Orchestrator routing, and on-demand Skills.
